# WO-172: OG template for per-broker guides
Status: open (design; Nora dispatches, WIP 5)
Vendor: codex
Agent: designer (Canva)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: Codex designer named by Nora
Source: docs/design/CANVA_BRIEFS_SEO.md CBS-03, requested by Sam Okafor (seo-growth); reviewer: in-house graphic-designer

## Goal
An editable Canva template for the per-broker guide share images, plus the 3 sample exports the brief lists, for approval before the rest. Full brief, exact on-image text, alt text and shared specs (palette, type, logo source): docs/design/CANVA_BRIEFS_SEO.md sections "Shared specs" and "CBS-03". The brief wins over this summary.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Size and format exactly as the brief; file size within the brief's target.
- On-image text is the brief's text, word for word; no other words.
- Colours and type from the brief's shared specs (brand/v3/tokens-notes.md); the logo only from brand/logo/final, placed unaltered.
- Text contrast at least 4.5:1 against its background; readable as a small thumbnail.
- No real personal data, no real people's photos, no broker or bureau logos.
- One row per file in brand/codex/MANIFEST.md: file, WO, Canva design link, Canva stock elements used (or "none"), alt text from the brief.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- brand/codex/WO-172/ (new files only)
- brand/codex/MANIFEST.md (append your rows)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
brand/ outside brand/codex/, web/, src/, every other file. No GitHub commits or PRs for this WO; status goes on the WO-172 issue as a comment.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md and a comment on the WO-172 issue in FreeMyID/freemyid-pm when done. The graphic-designer reviews, then Sam files the web placement request.
